metadata.description: Small, plain-text agent plugins from Kit: a pre-merge ship check, a plain-English diff review, a plan-first feature flow, and six offline StoreKit pre-flight checks.

plugins.name: kit-ship-check
plugins.description: Pre-commit gate: runs test, lint and type check and prints a PASS/FAIL table. Anything that couldn't run counts as FAIL.

plugins.name: kit-explain-diff
plugins.description: Plain-English read of your git diff with risky lines flagged as file:line.

plugins.name: kit-new-feature
plugins.description: Plan in 5 lines, wait for a yes, build in small steps, finish with a ship check.

plugins.name: kit-storekit-check
plugins.description: Six offline StoreKit / Xcode pre-flight file checks: bundled .storekit, distantFuture expiry, product ID drift, local-only intro offers, export-compliance key, prices in metadata text.
